source: This distinction is why “ZXNAME0000XZ is a faster kind of attention” can be misleading. It is better thought of as an algorithm and kernel family for evaluating attention efficiently on accelerators. A model can use causal masking, RoPE, ZXNAME0001XZ/ZXNAME0002XZ, or other attention features and still use a ZXNAME0003XZ implementation underneath.
zh: 这种区别就是为什么“ZXNAME0000XZ 是一种更快的注意力”可能会产生误导。最好将其视为一种算法和内核系列，用于有效评估加速器上的注意力。模型可以使用因果屏蔽、RoPE、ZXNAME0001XZ/ZXNAME0002XZ 或其他注意功能，并且仍然在下面使用 ZXNAME0003XZ 实现。
